notes:
CRM: Rule 'note must not be empty' on QA layout; field qa_vr_note set READ-ONLY for profile User. CRM User (profile User) saves a new record without the note (can't type it) -> 422 'QA H6 note is required'. The user is blocked by a field they cannot change. Owner still blocked as expected (422). Zoho CRM skips a rule when the field is read-only for the profile (Z11)
DESK: Desk Agent with qa_vr_note READ-ONLY (field permission on the Desk Agent profile): saving a ticket without the note -> 422 'QA H6 note is required'; the agent is blocked by a field they cannot change. Owner also blocked (correct)
